# FG-WEB-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 429 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `login_start_is_rate_limited_per_peer` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 短い間に要求が多すぎます。少し待ってからもう一度お試しください。
- en: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
- id: Terlalu banyak permintaan dalam waktu singkat. Tunggu sebentar lalu coba lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

A rate-limited route was requested more often than its limit from one connection peer (ADR-0021 §3): `GET /-/auth/login` allows 20 starts and `GET /-/auth/callback` 20 callbacks per peer per minute, each with its own counter (an IPv6 peer counts as its /64), so nobody can flood the identity provider's authorization or token endpoint through GitStation. `GET /api/v1/namespaces/resolve?prefix=true` (M2 MR6, the SPA's rescue of GitHub-shaped URLs, ADR-0015) allows 60 requests per signed-in user per minute (`route=resolve_prefix`; one request resolves every leading prefix of the path), checked after the path is validated and the token scope decided, before any lookup. `GET /api/v1/users?search=` allows 120 searches per signed-in user per minute (`route=user_search`). A refused callback also clears the state cookie, so the user starts the sign-in again. The peer is the TCP peer address until the proxy layout is decided (ADR-0019 open question). Nothing was done; the answer carries `Retry-After`. M3 I1c: `GET /api/v1/integrations/{id}/events` and `…/events/cursor` allow one read in flight per integration (per process); a concurrent one is refused at once with `reason=feed_read_in_flight` and `Retry-After: 1` (the consumer retries; nothing was read). M4 C5: a job's log (`GET …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/jobs/{job_id}/log`) and a pipeline's diagnosis (`GET …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/diagnosis`) allow 120 reads per caller per minute together (`route=ci_output`) and 2 running per caller at once (`route=ci_output reason=in_flight`, `Retry-After: 1`), checked after the decision on the project and before any lookup (each may measure the default branch's tip with git and read a 1 MiB page).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `route` (`login`, `callback`, `resolve_prefix` or `user_search`), `limit` and `window_s` (never the address, which is personal data; `resolve_prefix` and `user_search` also `retry_after_s`). The per-caller limits are tested by `prefix_resolution_is_rate_limited_per_caller` and `the_user_search_is_rate_limited_per_caller` (forge-web). Many 429 behind a reverse proxy mean every user shares the proxy's peer address — the open question of ADR-0019. The feed's refusal carries `reason=feed_read_in_flight`, `integration_id` and `retry_after_s=1` (test `a_second_concurrent_read_of_the_same_integration_is_429`); many of them mean the consumer polls in parallel (runbook integration-feed-lag). `route=ci_output` (with `reason=in_flight` for the concurrency cap; test `the_ci_output_reads_are_capped_per_caller`): one user or agent pages logs in a loop or in parallel — find the user in the same request_id's events (runbook checks-reporting, H).

## 対処 (fix)

Wait `Retry-After` seconds. If a proxy in front of GitStation makes every user one peer, record it in the incident record and decide the client-address source (ADR-0019 open question) before raising the limit.
